value.main_text_excerpt:
We respect your right to data privacy and have here listed when we process, how and to whom we transfer your personal data.
        All data will be processed confidentially, with highest degree of care and security measures.
        Who we are
          Zealth is a Nordic-founded health economics and market access consultancy supporting pharmaceutical and biotech companies globally.
          Zealth is part of Zealth Group.
        
        General information
          This Privacy Policy applies for Zealth ApS (“Zealth”).
          When you use our Service, you accept the collection, use and sharing of your personal data under this Privacy Policy.
          We have designed our website without the use of cookie technology. There will not be any tracking or storing of your behavior and visits to our website: zealthcon.com.
          Please read the Privacy Policy thoroughly in order to understand how we process your personal data.
        
        Data controller and contact information
          Zealth ApS is the data controller for personal data collected through our services.
          If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy or the information we collect, please contact us: contact@zealthcon.com
        
        Data protection legislation
          Zealth processes personal information in different situations and in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”).
          Personal data is regarded in accordance with the GDPR and means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.
        
        When do we process your data?
          We process your data in the following situations (hereafter referred to as our “Services”):
          
          You can read more about our processing by clicking one of the links above.
        
        
        When you sign up to a symposium
          We process below personal data, based on your sign up to a symposium:
          - Name
- Job title
- Company name
- Company address
- Email address
The purpose of the processing of this data is to handle your sign up to and participation in the specific symposium.
          We process this data according to the GDPR art. 6, para 1, lit. b, after which personal information can be processed if it is necessary for the performance of a contract which you are a party to.
          The data will be stored until after the symposium you have signed up for has taken place.
        
        When you participate in a symposium
          During the course of a symposium we will record films and take photos of the event. If you appear in the films or photos, we have legitimate interest in processing and storing of your picture.
          The legal basis for the processing of this data is art. 6, para 1, lit. f in the GDPR after which personal information can be processed for the purposes of the legitimate interests of Zealth. Zealth has a legitimate interest in using the films or photos for the purpose of promoting these types of event to other customers and future events.
          The data will be stored until after the symposium you have signed up for has taken place.
        
        If you are a customer or a potential customer
          We will store your data – if we have commercial and legitimate interest in you as a customer or potential customer.
          - Name
- Job title
- Company name
- Company address
- Email address (if provided by you)
- LinkedIn profile name
The legal basis for the processing of this data is art. 6, para 1, lit. f in the GDPR after which personal information can be processed for the purposes of the legitimate interests of Zealth. Zealth has a legitimate interest in using these master data for the purpose of sales pitches and promotion activities.
        
        If you are a vendor or a potential vendor
          We will store your data – if we have commercial and legitimate interest in you as a vendor or potential vendor.
          - Name
- Job title
- Company name
- Company address
- Email address (if provided by you)
- LinkedIn profile name
The legal basis for the processing of this data is art. 6, para 1, lit. f in the GDPR after which personal information can be processed for the purposes of the legitimate interests of Zealth. Zealth has a legitimate interest in using these master data for the purpose of getting business support, goods and services.
        
        When we store your information in our CV bank
          When you apply for a position or we contact you for a potential position we store and process your personal data in our recruitment bank. We only process below personal data:
          - Name
- Email
- Telephone no.
- Position and previous positions
- Education
- Skills
Information you have provided to us in your CV, application or other attachments.
          The purpose of the processing of this data is to evaluate your qualifications and suitability for employment at Zealth and to contact you for a potential positi
